name: text-proximity-repel
title: Pointer Proximity Repel
description: Con trỏ lướt ngang qua dòng chữ, các chữ cái gần nó bị đẩy dạt ra ngoài và hơi nghiêng, càng gần càng xa, rồi êm ái trở về chỗ.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-proximity-repel, written here): Scripted cursor: bottom-left off-frame (0.4 s) → just left of the text (0.9 s) → straight across the line, linear, to just past its end (2.3 s) → out bottom-right (2.85 s). Char target = push away from the cursor of 24 px × (1 − d / 64 px) inside 64 px (recipe R 120, max 30); it closes 15 % of the gap per 60 fps frame. Tilt 0.012 rad per px of x push; tint to accent (full at 14 px); faint ghost at rest while displaced. Loop 4 s. Params: bán kính (64 px) · độ đẩy tối đa (24 px) · độ bám (0.15 / khung). The pointer comes in from the lower left, crosses the line at a steady speed and leaves to the lower right; the smoothing is stepped on the film clock.
